name: Gray buckeye
desc: Gray buckeye (Junonia grisea): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Junonia grisea, also known as the gray buckeye, grey buckeye, or Western buckeye, is a species in the butterfly family Nymphalidae. It is found in North America, west of the Rocky Mountains.
